    data-portal-ui/src/pages/out-for-delivery/useFilterOptions.ts1 Major1 个问题
    MAJORL49-57并发安全⚠ 证据待核实
    原因： useFilterOptions.ts 把 state、raw、inflight、derivedFor 和 listeners 放在模块级共享，并通过 emit() / ensure() 在多个组件订阅与 fetchOfdFilterOptions() 异步回调之间直接读写，但新增代码没有任何版本号、请求代次或取消机制来保证“后返回的旧请求结果不会覆盖新状态”。这属于前端共享单例缓存的竞态更新问题，尤其 invalidateOfdFilterOptions() 只把 raw 置空并 emit(EMPTY)，并不会终止之前已经发出的请求。 影响： 当用户触发 Refresh、快速切换语言或页面多实例并发挂载时，旧的 in-flight 请求仍可能在失效后回写 raw 和 state，把本应失效的数据重新发布给所有订阅者；在权限范围、语言标签或筛选主数据刚变更的场景下，会导致页面继续展示过期选项，形成错误的数据范围提示，间接影响用户对可见数据边界的判断。

Rebuilding 139k options is55// the expensive part, so it is redone only when the LANGUAGE actually changes,56// not on every render or every subscriber.57let derivedFor: string | null = null;5859const listeners = new Set<() => void>();6061function emit(next: OfdOptionsState) {62  state = next;
    修复建议与测试场景
    修复建议

    给模块级缓存增加请求代次校验或取消机制：在 ensure() 发起请求前递增一个 requestId，在 .then/.catch/.finally 中仅当回调携带的 requestId 仍是当前值时才允许 publish/emit；同时 invalidateOfdFilterOptions() 应使旧请求结果失效。示例： 

    let requestSeq = 0;

function ensure(unnamedDriver: string) {
  if (raw) {
    if (derivedFor !== unnamedDriver) publish(unnamedDriver);
    return;
  }
  if (inflight || state.failed) return;

  const seq = ++requestSeq;
  emit({ options: null, loading: true, failed: false });
  inflight = fetchOfdFilterOptions()
    .then((data) => {
      if (seq !== requestSeq) return;
      raw = data;
      publish(unnamedDriver);
    })
    .catch(() => {
      if (seq !== requestSeq) return;
      emit({ options: null, loading: false, failed: true });
    })
    .finally(() => {
      if (seq === requestSeq) inflight = null;
    });
}

export function invalidateOfdFilterOptions() {
  requestSeq++;
  raw = null;
  inflight = null;
  derivedFor = null;
  emit(EMPTY);
}

    测试场景

    1）页面加载后立即点击 Refresh，使第一次请求尚未返回时触发失效；2）让第一次请求晚于第二次请求返回；3）验证最终下拉选项不会被第一次旧响应覆盖。再补充语言切换并发场景，确认旧语言标签不会回写覆盖新语言。

PAGE HEADER PATTERN 513   Eyebrow tag → page title → optional subtitle → optional actions on right. 514   Used across every dashboard / form page. 515   ============================================================ */ 516.page-header { 517  display: flex; 518  align-items: flex-start; 519  justify-content: space-between; 520  gap: var(--sp-6); 521  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6); 522} 523.page-header__main { min-width: 0; } 524.page-header__actions { 525  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-2); 526  flex-shrink: 0; 527} 528 529.eyebrow { 530  display: inline-block; 531  font-size: var(--fs-eyebrow); 532  font-weight: var(--fw-bold); 533  color: var(--text-muted); 534  letter-spacing: var(--ls-tag); 535  text-transform: uppercase; 536  margin-bottom: var(--sp-1); 537} 538 539.page-title { 540  font-size: var(--fs-2xl); 541  font-weight: var(--fw-bold); 542  color: var(--text-primary); 543  line-height: var(--lh-tight); 544  margin: 0; 545} 546.page-title--lg { font-size: var(--fs-3xl); } 547 548.page-subtitle { 549  font-size: var(--fs-md); 550  color: var(--text-secondary); 551  margin: var(--sp-1) 0 0; 552  line-height: var(--lh-snug); 553} 554 555 556/* ============================================================ 557   REPORT INFO (报表介绍) — REQUIRED on every dashboard. 558   A short introduction block placed directly under .page-header, 559   before the first content panel. States what the report is, 560   its data source, granularity, refresh cadence, and owner so a 561   first-time viewer knows what they're looking at. 562 563   Markup: 564     <section class="report-info"> 565       <h2 class="report-info__title">◷ About this report</h2> 566       <p class="report-info__desc">One-paragraph purpose…</p> 567       <div class="report-info__meta"> 568         <span class="report-info__item"><strong>Data source</strong> …</span> 569         <span class="report-info__item"><strong>Granularity</strong> …</span> 570         <span class="report-info__item"><strong>Refresh</strong> …</span> 571         <span class="report-info__item"><strong>Owner</strong> …</span> 572       </div> 573     </section> 574   ============================================================ */ 575.report-info { 576  background: var(--info-soft); 577  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); 578  border-left: 3px solid var(--info); 579  border-radius: var(--r-lg); 580  padding: var(--sp-4) var(--sp-5); 581  margin-bottom: var(--sp-6); 582} 583.report-info__title { 584  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-2); 585  font-size: var(--fs-sm); 586  font-weight: var(--fw-bold); 587  color: var(--text-primary); 588  margin: 0 0 var(--sp-1); 589} 590.report-info__desc { 591  font-size: var(--fs-sm); 592  color: var(--text-secondary); 593  line-height: var(--lh-snug); 594  margin: 0; 595} 596.report-info__meta { 597  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--sp-2) var(--sp-6); 598  margin-top: var(--sp-3); 599} 600.report-info__item { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-muted); } 601.report-info__item strong { 602  color: var(--text-secondary); 603  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); 604  margin-right: 4px; 605} 606 607 608/* ============================================================ 609   UNIVERSAL REPORT INFO (报表说明) — modal + trigger. 610   Auto-mounted by Portal.mountReportInfo() on any page that 611   defines window.REPORT_INFO. The trigger sits in the page 612   header actions (top-right); if there is no header, a small 613   fixed button is placed top-right. Content is locale-pure and 614   switches with the global EN / 中文 toggle. 615   Classes are spx-ri-* to avoid clashing with module-local CSS. 616   ============================================================ */ 617.spx-ri-fab { 618  position: fixed; top: var(--sp-4); right: var(--sp-5); 619  z-index: calc(var(--z-modal) - 1); 620} 621.spx-ri-mask { 622  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.55); 623  display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; 624  z-index: var(--z-modal); padding: var(--sp-6); 625} 626.spx-ri-mask.open { display: flex; } 627.spx-ri { 628  background: var(--bg-surface); border-radius: var(--r-xl); 629  width: 100%; max-width: 920px; max-height: 90vh; overflow: auto; 630  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop); 631} 632.spx-ri__head { 633  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; 634  gap: var(--sp-4); padding: var(--sp-5) var(--sp-6); 635  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); position: sticky; top: 0; 636  background: var(--bg-surface); z-index: 1; 637} 638.spx-ri__eyebrow { 639  font-size: var(--fs-eyebrow); } 651 652.spx-ri-section { margin-bottom: var(--sp-6); } 653.spx-ri-section:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; } 654.spx-ri-section__title { 655  font-size: var(--fs-eyebrow); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); TABLES1136   ============================================================ */1137.data-table {1138  width: 100%;1139  border-collapse: separate;1140  border-spacing: 0;1141  font-size: var(--fs-sm);1142  background: var(--bg-surface);1143  border: 1px solid var(--border);1144  border-radius: var(--r-lg);1145  overflow: hidden;1146}1147.data-table th, .data-table td {1148  padding: 10px 14px;1149  text-align: left;1150  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft);1151  vertical-align: middle;1152}1153.data-table thead th {1154  background: var(--bg-sunken);1155  font-size: var(--fs-xs);1156  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);1157  color: var(--text-secondary);1158  letter-spacing: 0.2px;1159  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);1160}1161.data-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); }1162.data-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }11631164.data-table .num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }1165.data-table .col-target {1166  font-size: var(--fs-micro);1167  color: var(--text-muted);1168  font-weight: var(--fw-regular);1169}117011711172/* ------------------------------------------------------------1173   REPORT TABLE  (.rpt) — a dense report grid that carries its own1174   brand-blue header. The TITLE and that table's FILTERS share ONE row:1175   title left, controls right. Filters therefore never claim space above1176   the table: the view is the table. Every report table uses the same1177   header, so the controls land in the same place on every page.1178   Deliberately angular (--r-xs).11791180   The title used to sit centred on its own row with the filters stacked1181   underneath, which cost ~28px of vertical space per table — on a page1182   that stacks two tables, that is a whole row of data pushed off screen.1183   The bar wraps rather than overflows, so a long filter set still fits.11841185   <section class="rpt">1186     <div class="rpt__head">1187       <div class="rpt__title">…</div>1188       <div class="rpt__tools"> controls </div>1189     </div>1190     <div class="rpt__scroll"><table class="rpt-table">…</table></div>1191   </section>1192   ------------------------------------------------------------ */1193.rpt {1194  background: var(--bg-surface);1195  border: 1px solid var(--border);1196  border-radius: var(--r-xs);1197  overflow: hidden;1198}1199.rpt + .rpt { margin-top: var(--sp-4); }1200.rpt__head {1201  display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;1202  gap: var(--sp-1) var(--sp-3);1203  padding: 4px 10px;1204  background: var(--brand);1205  color: var(--text-on-brand);1206}1207.rpt__title {1208  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-2);1209  flex: 0 0 auto;1210  font-size: var(--fs-sm);1211  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);1212  letter-spacing: 0.2px;1213  line-height: 1.25;1214}1215/* Export sits beside the name of the thing it exports. It is always1216   WYSIWYG: it writes the table exactly as currently rendered (level,1217   filters and date range all applied). */1218.rpt__dl { flex: 0 0 auto; }1219.rpt__tools {1220  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end;1221  gap: var(--sp-2); flex-wrap: wrap;1222  margin-left: auto;1223}1224.rpt__sep { font-size: var(--fs-xs); opacity: 0.75; }12251226/* ---- .rpt--spx · SpeedX corporate header ---------------------------------1227   Opt-in modifier on the .rpt wrapper, same reasoning as .rpt-table--center:1228   a dozen other reports share these components and keep the portal blue.12291230   The class recolours the TITLE BAR to navy. The table's <thead> takes a1231   LIGHT band instead (--spx-thead), and that split is the point: the title1232   bar names the report, the thead names the columns, and painting both navy1233   fused them into one slab you had to read to take apart. Light-on-navy also1234   keeps the column labels the lightest thing on the page, which is where the1235   eye should land first when scanning a grid.12361237   --brand itself is NOT touched: it is this portal's interaction colour1238   (links, focus rings, active nav, drill hover) and must stay a control1239   colour, not a company colour. */1240.rpt--spx .rpt__head { background: var(--spx-navy); }12411242/* `.rpt--spx .rpt-table thead .c0` (0,3,1) has to out-specify1243   `.rpt-table thead .c0` (0,2,1), which pins the sticky corner cell to1244   --bg-sunken and would otherwise leave one odd grey cell in the band. */1245.rpt--spx .rpt-table thead th,1246.rpt--spx .rpt-table thead .c0 {1247  background: var(--spx-thead);1248  color: var(--spx-thead-text);1249  border-bottom-color: var(--spx-thead-line);1250}1251.rpt--spx .rpt-table thead th.grp { border-left-color: var(--spx-thead-line); }1252.rpt--spx .rpt-table thead .c0    { border-right-color: var(--spx-thead-line); }1253/* Where the head meets the body, one real rule — the head is no longer a1254   solid dark block that separates itself. */1255.rpt--spx .rpt-table thead tr:last-child th { border-bottom-color: var(--border-strong); }12561257/* Saturday / Sunday. Set on the DATE header cell only: the weekday belongs to1258   the column label, not to the readings underneath it, and tinting a whole1259   column would compete with the rate verdicts that colour the cells. */1260.rpt--spx .rpt-table thead th.wknd { background: var(--spx-thead-wknd); }12611262/* The network total takes the TITLE BAR's navy. The row is not one more reading1263   among the rows above it — it is the whole report in one line — so it is1264   painted as part of the report's frame rather than as part of its body.1265   It out-specifies the .rate-hit / .rate-miss verdict fills below, which means1266   the total row carries NO verdict colour. That is the trade: the row reads as1267   a frame, and its pass/fail has to be read from the number against the1268   target in the hover.12691270   The :hover selectors below are NOT optional and they are NOT symmetric with1271   the rest for style. The generic body-hover rule is1272   `.rpt-table tbody tr:hover td:not(.rate-hit):not(.rate-miss)` — the two1273   :not()s each count as a class, so it lands at (0,5,3) and beat the first1274   version of this block at (0,4,3). It set only `background`, so on hover the1275   total row took the light grey hover fill while KEEPING the white text set1276   here: white on light grey, invisible. Matching its :not() shape is what1277   raises this to (0,6,3) and wins.12781279   The values are the same as the resting state on purpose. The total row is1280   the report's frame, not a row you point at — there is nothing to reveal by1281   hovering it, so it does not react. */1282.rpt--spx .rpt-table tr.is-total td,1283.rpt--spx .rpt-table tr.is-total .c0,1284.rpt--spx .rpt-table tr.is-total td.rate-hit,1285.rpt--spx .rpt-table tr.is-total td.rate-miss,1286.rpt--spx .rpt-table tbody tr.is-total:hover td:not(.rate-hit):not(.rate-miss),1287.rpt--spx .rpt-table tbody tr.is-total:hover .c0,1288.rpt--spx .rpt-table tbody tr.is-total:hover td.rate-hit,1289.rpt--spx .rpt-table tbody tr.is-total:hover td.rate-miss {1290  background: var(--spx-navy);1291  color: var(--text-on-brand);1292  border-color: var(--spx-navy-line);1293}12941295/* The two "selected / ready" pills on the bar — Confirm, and the active level1296   button — print their label in --brand, the only place the portal blue would1297   still appear INSIDE a navy header. They take the header's own colour.12981299   The pill's BACKGROUND has to be pinned too, and that is not cosmetic. Both1300   rules set `background: var(--bg-surface)`, which follows the page theme —1301   but the bar underneath is saturated navy in BOTH themes. In dark mode1302   --bg-surface is #161922, so navy-on-near-black gives a contrast ratio of1303   1.3:1: the Confirm button and the active level button become invisible, and1304   the level selector looks like it simply does not respond. --gray-0 is a1305   fixed white that the dark theme does not override, so the pill stays white1306   on navy (13.5:1) whatever the theme. */1307.rpt--spx .rpt-ctl--go,1308.rpt--spx .rpt-ctl--go:hover,1309.rpt--spx .seg--onbrand .seg__btn.active {1310  background: var(--gray-0);1311  color: var(--spx-navy);1312}13131314/* compact controls sitting ON the brand bar */1315.rpt-ctl {1316  font: inherit; font-size: var(--fs-xs); line-height: 1;1317  height: 22px; padding: 0 8px;1318  color: var(--text-primary);1319  background: var(--bg-surface);1320  border: 1px solid transparent;1321  border-radius: var(--r-xs);1322  outline: none;1323  cursor: pointer;1324}1325.rpt-ctl:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-on-brand) 45%, transparent); }1326.rpt-ctl:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--text-on-brand); }1327select.rpt-ctl {1328  appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none;1329  padding-right: 22px;1330  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='10' height='6' viewBox='0 0 10 6'><path fill='none' stroke='%236b7280' stroke-width='1.5' d='M1 1l4 4 4-4'/></svg>");1331  background-repeat: no-repeat;1332  background-position: right 7px center;1333}1334input.rpt-ctl[type="date"] { padding: 0 6px; }1335input.rpt-ctl[type="search"] { cursor: text; width: 148px; }13361337/* Confirm / Cancel — filters are STAGED, never live. Both buttons stay hidden1338   while the view matches the controls, and appear together the moment a control1339   is touched: Confirm commits the draft, Cancel throws it away and puts every1340   control back to what is on screen. This pair is the portal-wide contract for1341   any filter set — do not wire a control to re-query on change. */1342.rpt-ctl--go {1343  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);1344  color: var(--brand);1345  background: var(--bg-surface);1346}1347.rpt-ctl--go:hover {1348  background: var(--bg-surface);1349  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-on-brand) 55%, transparent);1350}1351.rpt-ctl--cancel {1352  color: var(--text-on-brand);1353  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-on-brand) 18%, transparent);1354}1355.rpt-ctl--cancel:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-on-brand) 28%, transparent); box-shadow: none; }13561357/* segmented control on the brand bar */1358.seg--onbrand { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-on-brand) 20%, transparent);1359  border-color: transparent; border-radius: var(--r-xs); padding: 2px; }1360.seg--onbrand .seg__btn { color: var(--text-on-brand); border-radius: var(--r-xs);1361  padding: 2px 9px; font-size: var(--fs-xs); }1362.seg--onbrand .seg__btn.active { background: var(--bg-surface); color: var(--brand); box-shadow: none; }13631364.rpt__scroll { overflow: auto; max-height: 64vh; }1365.rpt__empty { padding: var(--sp-10); text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--fs-sm); }13661367.rpt-table {1368  border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0;1369  width: max-content; min-width: 100%;1370  font-size: var(--fs-xs);1371}1372/* Flat on purpose. A report grid is read by scanning DOWN a column, and every1373   pixel of row padding is one fewer row on screen — the numbers only have to1374   be legible, not roomy. 22px is the floor at --fs-xs with 1px of breathing1375   room top and bottom. */1376.rpt-table th, .rpt-table td {1377  padding: 1px 6px; height: 22px; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap;1378  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft);1379}1380.rpt-table thead th {1381  position: sticky;1382  background: var(--bg-sunken);1383  color: var(--text-secondary);1384  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);1385  text-align: right;1386  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);1387  z-index: 2;1388}1389/* Header row 1 is pinned to 30px whether or not it carries a second line, so1390   the sticky offset for row 2 below is a constant and not a guess. */1391.rpt-table thead tr:first-child th  { top: 0; height: 30px; }1392.rpt-table thead tr:nth-child(2) th { top: 30px; }1393/* The weekday under a date. Small enough to read as an annotation on the date1394   above it rather than as a column of its own. */1395.rpt-table th .wd {1396  display: block;1397  font-size: 9px; font-weight: var(--fw-regular);1398  line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.2px;1399  opacity: 0.7;1400}1401.rpt-table th.t-left, .rpt-table td.t-left { text-align: left; }1402.rpt-table th.t-center { text-align: center; }1403.rpt-table td.num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }1404/* Centre every cell — opt-in per table, not a global change to .rpt-table,1405   which a dozen other reports also use. Doubling the class raises specificity1406   just enough to beat the alignment rules above (.rpt-table thead th → right,1407   td.num → right, .t-left → left) without reaching for !important. .num keeps1408   its tabular figures; only the alignment moves. */1409.rpt-table.rpt-table--center th,1410.rpt-table.rpt-table--center td,1411.rpt-table.rpt-table--center thead th,1412.rpt-table.rpt-table--center th.t-left,1413.rpt-table.rpt-table--center td.t-left,1414.rpt-table.rpt-table--center td.num { text-align: center; }1415/* …except columns of PEOPLE. Codes (ATL, BNA, a driver id) are the same width1416   every row, so centring them still reads as a column; names are not — "Ethan"1417   next to "zhehao wang/Philip Sanders" centred gives a ragged edge on BOTH1418   sides and there is nothing left to scan down. Same specificity as the block1419   above (0,3,1), winning only by coming later — keep it below. */1420.rpt-table.rpt-table--center th.person,1421.rpt-table.rpt-table--center td.person { text-align: left; }14221423/* ---- resizable columns (Portal.resizableColumns) ------------------------1424   The grip is a pseudo-element on every header cell's right edge. It is not1425   a separate handle element: the header is rebuilt on every render, and a1426   handle that has to be re-injected each time is a handle that will one day1427   be missing. A pseudo-element cannot go missing.14281429   `.is-fixed` is added only after the first drag. Until then the table sizes1430   itself to its content — which is what compact means — and NOTHING here1431   applies. Once fixed, cells must clip: the reason to drag a column narrower1432   is to stop a long fleet name from setting the whole column's width, and1433   without overflow that is exactly what would keep happening. */1434.rpt-table--resizable thead th::after {1435  content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;1436  width: 7px; cursor: col-resize;1437}1438.rpt-table--resizable thead th:hover::after { background: var(--brand); opacity: 0.35; }1439/* The drag guide. Lives on <body>, viewport-positioned and moved by transform,1440   so dragging never touches table geometry — see Portal.resizableColumns.1441   --z-dropdown puts it over the sidebar and the sticky header, under a modal. */1442.rpt-resize-guide {1443  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 2px; height: 100vh;1444  background: var(--brand); opacity: 0.85;1445  pointer-events: none; z-index: var(--z-dropdown);1446}1447.rpt-table--resizable.is-fixed { table-layout: fixed; min-width: 0; }1448.rpt-table--resizable.is-fixed th,1449.rpt-table--resizable.is-fixed td { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }14501451.rpt-table td.dim { color: var(--text-muted); }1452.rpt-table tbody tr:hover td:not(.rate-hit):not(.rate-miss) { background: var(--bg-hover); }1453.rpt-table .grp { border-left: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }14541455/* sticky identity column */1456.rpt-table .c0 {1457  position: sticky; left: 0; z-index: 1;1458  background: var(--bg-surface);1459  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);1460  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);1461}1462.rpt-table thead .c0 { background: var(--bg-sunken); z-index: 4; }1463.rpt-table tbody tr:hover .c0 { background: var(--bg-hover); }14641465.rpt-table tr.is-total td {1466  position: sticky; bottom: 0; z-index: 1;1467  background: var(--bg-sunken);1468  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);1469  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-strong);1470}1471.rpt-table tr.is-total .c0 { z-index: 3; background: var(--bg-sunken); }1472.rpt-table tr.is-total:hover td, .rpt-table tr.is-total:hover .c0 { background: var(--bg-sunken); }14731474/* Rate against target — a soft background fill carries the verdict, the text1475   colour never changes: green = at/above target, red = below, no fill = no value.1476   Every fill is mixed into its OWN surface rather than into transparent, so the1477   pinned .is-total row stays fully opaque and body rows never show through it1478   while you scroll. Listed against :hover too so the verdict is never1479   overpainted. */1480.rpt-table td.rate-hit,1481.rpt-table tbody tr:hover td.rate-hit   { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 14%, var(--bg-surface)); }1482.rpt-table td.rate-miss,1483.rpt-table tbody tr:hover td.rate-miss  { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 12%, var(--bg-surface)); }1484.rpt-table tr.is-total td.rate-hit,1485.rpt-table tbody tr.is-total:hover td.rate-hit   { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 14%, var(--bg-sunken)); }1486.rpt-table tr.is-total td.rate-miss,1487.rpt-table tbody tr.is-total:hover td.rate-miss  { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 12%, var(--bg-sunken)); }1488.rate-na { color: var(--text-faint); }14891490/* Any cell that opens the miss detail. Target columns are never drillable. */1491.rpt-table td.is-drill { cursor: pointer; }1492.rpt-table td.is-drill:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--brand); }14931494/* ---- miss-detail modal (Portal.openDetail) ---- */1495.spx-dt-mask {1496  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.55);1497  display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center;1498  z-index: var(--z-modal); padding: var(--sp-6);1499}1500.spx-dt-mask.open { display: flex; }1501.spx-dt {1502  background: var(--bg-surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-xs);1503  width: min(96vw, 1080px); max-height: 88vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column;1504  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);1505}1506.spx-dt__head {1507  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-3);1508  padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--brand); color: var(--text-on-brand);1509}1510.spx-dt__title { font-size: var(--fs-lg); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); margin: 0; }1511.spx-dt__meta { font-size: var(--fs-xs); opacity: 0.85; }1512.spx-dt__spacer { margin-left: auto; }1513.spx-dt__body { overflow: auto; }1514.spx-dt__foot {1515  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--sp-4);1516  padding: 8px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);1517  font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-muted);1518}1519.spx-dt__pg {1520  font: inherit; font-size: var(--fs-xs);1521  border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-surface); color: var(--text-primary);1522  border-radius: var(--r-xs); padding: 3px 10px; cursor: pointer;1523}1524.spx-dt__pg:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--brand); color: var(--brand); }1525.spx-dt__pg:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }1526.spx-dt__empty { padding: var(--sp-10); text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--fs-sm); }1527.spx-dt__mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); }152815291530/* ============================================================1531   11. STATUS & FEEDBACK1532   ============================================================ */15331534/* Tiny status dot — for live indicators (e.g. "● Live") */1535.status-dot {1536  display: inline-block;1537  width: 8px; height: 8px;1538  border-radius: 50%;1539  margin-right: 6px;1540  background: var(--text-faint);1541}1542.status-dot--success { background: var(--success); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--success-soft); }1543.status-dot--danger  { background: var(--danger);  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--danger-soft); }1544.status-dot--warning { background: var(--warning); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--warning-soft); }15451546/* Alert chip — inline pill carrying a single warning/info message */1547.alert-chip {1548  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;1549  padding: 4px 10px;1550  font-size: var(--fs-xs);1551  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);1552  border-radius: var(--r-pill);1553}1554.alert-chip--warning { background: var(--warning-soft); color: var(--warning); }1555.alert-chip--danger  { background: var(--danger-soft);  color: var(--danger); }1556.alert-chip--info    { background: var(--info-soft);    color: var(--info); }1557.alert-chip--success { background: var(--success-soft); color: var(--success); }15581559/* Step marker — small numeric badge "01" "02" used before sub-panel titles */1560.step-marker {1561  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;1562  width: 22px; height: 22px;1563  border-radius: var(--r-sm);1564  font-size: var(--fs-xs);1565  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);1566  color: var(--brand);1567  background: var(--brand-soft);1568  margin-right: var(--sp-2);1569  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;1570}157115721573/* ============================================================1574   12. HOMEPAGE CARDS1575   ============================================================ */1576.module-grid {1577  display: grid;1578  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);1579  gap: var(--sp-6);1580}1581@media (max-width: 1100px) { .module-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }1582@media (max-width: 700px)  { .module-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }15831584.module-card {1585  background: var(--bg-surface);1586  border: 1px solid var(--border);1587  border-radius: var(--r-xl);1588  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);1589  padding: 36px 28px;1590  display: flex; flex-direction: column;1591  align-items: center; text-align: center; justify-content: center;1592  color: var(--text-primary);1593  transition: transform var(--t-base), box-shadow var(--t-base), border-color var(--t-base);1594  cursor: pointer;1595  min-height: 200px;1596}1597.module-card:hover {1598  transform: translateY(-2px);1599  box-shadow: var(--shadow-raised);1600  border-color: var(--border-strong);1601}1602.module-card .module-icon {1603  width: 48px; This report scores the SC’s OWN delivery capability — the parcels are already at the station, so what is left is whether they went out on time and got delivered on time. Upstream linehaul and sortation are deliberately out of scope. Two metrics, one column per day, stacked as in the source report: the On-time Delivery Rate split into Day 1 and Day 2 against 97% / 99%, and the On-time OFD Rate against a 90% target. Opens on the NINE DAYS ENDING YESTERDAY — today is an open cohort and is never in the default window. Both tables open at region level and can be taken down to SC, Fleet or Driver. The same two metrics for one day, spread across the hours they happened in, are in Single Day.',2561        zh:'看一个站点这段时间的派送表现。本报表考核的是 SC 自己的派送能力——包裹已经到站，剩下的只有能不能按时发出去、能不能按时送到；上游的发车与分拣不在考核范围内。两项指标按日期铺开、每日一列，沿用源报表的上下排布：及时签收率按 Day 1 / Day 2 拆分并对照 97% / 99%，出仓及时率对照 90% 目标值。默认展示截至昨天的九天——当天是未完结批次，永不进默认区间。两张表默认大区级，可下钻至 SC、车队或司机。同样这两项指标在单日内按小时的分布，见「单日」。',2562      },2563      ownership: [2564        { kind:'danger', en:'Quality Control', zh:'质量控制' },2565        { kind:'brand',  en:'Regional Operations', zh:'大区运营' },2566      ],2567      refresh: { en:'Near real-time', zh:'近实时' },2568      concepts: [2569        { term:{ en:'On-time OFD Rate', zh:'出仓及时率' },2570          desc:{ en:'OFD = out for delivery. For a date D the cohort is every parcel that went out for delivery on D — that is the DENOMINATOR. The NUMERATOR is the subset whose OFD scan landed before the configured cut-off clock (09:00 local by default). Rate = numerator ÷ denominator. Two configuration inputs drive it: the cut-off time and the target (90%).',2571                 zh:'OFD 即 out for delivery（出仓）。对日期 D，批次为当日所有出仓包裹，即分母；分子为其中出仓扫描发生在配置的截止时点（默认当地 09:00）之前的包裹。及时率 = 分子 ÷ 分母。由两项配置驱动：截止时点与目标值（90%）。' } },2572        { term:{ en:'On-time Delivery Rate', zh:'及时签收率' },2573          desc:{ en:'The cohort is every parcel that went OUT FOR DELIVERY on date D — the same denominator for both tiers. Day 1 is the share of that cohort with a POD by the end of D itself; Day 2 is the CUMULATIVE share with a POD by the end of D+1. Because Day 2 is cumulative over the same cohort, Day 2 is never below Day 1.',2574                 zh:'批次为日期 D 当天出仓的全部包裹——两档共用同一分母。Day 1 为该批次在 D 当日结束前完成签收（POD）的占比；Day 2 为截至 D+1 结束的累计签收占比。由于 Day 2 是同一批次的累计口径，Day 2 恒不低于 Day 1。' } },2575        { term:{ en:'Levels', zh:'层级' },2576          desc:{ en:'Region › SC › Fleet › Driver. The hierarchy is real — these are the SCs and fleets that actually serve each region. Coverage is not: On-time OFD is reported at region and fleet level, so SC rows are the mean of the fleets serving that SC and driver rows are a modelled roster around the fleet rate. On-time Delivery is reported at region level only, so everything below it is modelled around the region’s reported Day 1 / Day 2. Swap both in as soon as the warehouse publishes them.',2577                 zh:'大区 › SC › 车队 › 司机。层级本身是真实的——即各大区实际服务的 SC 与车队；覆盖度则不然：出仓及时率的源数据到大区与车队两级，因此 SC 行取该 SC 下各车队的均值，司机行为围绕车队值推导的名册。及时签收率仅有大区级源数据，其下各级均围绕该大区的 Day 1 / Day 2 推导。数仓发布后即可替换为真实值。' } },2578        { term:{ en:'Date coverage', zh:'日期覆盖' },2579          desc:{ en:'The date range is the same at every level — nine days ending yesterday by default — and drilling down does not change it. The reported region series currently runs two days longer than the fleet-level source, so at SC, Fleet and Driver level the two oldest columns have no cohort behind them and are blank. Blank means "no parcels in this range on this date", never zero.',2580                 zh:'日期区间在所有层级都是同一个——默认截至昨天的九天——下钻不会改变它。当前大区级上报序列比车队级源数据长两天，因此在 SC / 车队 / 司机层级，最早的两列没有对应批次，显示为空。空表示“该范围当日没有包裹”，不是零。' } },2581        { term:{ en:'Refresh', zh:'刷新' },2582          desc:{ en:'Near real-time. Today is a partial cohort — its figures keep climbing until the day closes — so the most recent column is not final. Read closed days for judgement and the open day for pace.',2583                 zh:'近实时。当日为未完结批次，数值会持续上升至当日结束，因此最新一列并非终值。判断表现应看已完结日期，当日数据用于观察节奏。' } },2584        { term:{ en:'Config resolution', zh:'配置口径' },2585          desc:{ en:'Both the cut-off clock and the target come from Configuration › Out for Delivery Report Configuration, and both are versioned by effective date. A report date is always scored against the version in force on that date, so changing a rule never rewrites history.',2586                 zh:'截止时点与目标值均取自“配置 › 出仓报表配置”，两者都按生效日期做版本管理。任一报表日期始终按当日生效的版本计算，调整规则不会改写历史数据。' } },2587        { term:{ en:'Target', zh:'目标值' },2588          desc:{ en:'Read it off a value cell — hovering one shows the rule that cell was scored against, for that date. The OFD rule spells itself out in full ("by 09:00 ≥ 90.00%") because the cut-off clock is a business variable; the delivery rule shows the threshold only ("Day 1 ≥ 97.00%"), because its closing clock is always 23:59 — D+0 for Day 1, D+1 for Day 2. Every date is scored against the version in force on that date, so a range spanning a configuration change carries two different targets and each cell tells you which one it got.',2589                 zh:'把鼠标停在任一数值格上，即显示该格所依据的规则（按该日期生效的版本）。出仓口径写完整规则（“09:00 前 ≥ 90.00%”），因为截止时点是业务变量；签收口径只写阈值（“Day 1 ≥ 97.00%”），因为其截止时点恒为 23:59（Day 1 在 D+0，Day 2 在 D+1）。每个日期均按当日生效版本判定，因此跨配置变更的区间里前后两段目标值不同，逐格可查。' } },2590        { term:{ en:'Miss detail', zh:'未达标明细' },2591          desc:{ en:'A miss is a parcel in that cell’s cohort that broke the rule: for the OFD metric its OFD scan is after the cut-off in force that day; for the delivery metric it left on time but its POD landed outside the Day window. Parcel-level rows are not in the source workbook yet, so the list is a deterministic sample derived from the cell — the same cell always returns the same parcels, and a worse rate returns a longer list. Point it at the warehouse query to make it live.',2592                 zh:'未达标即该单元格批次中违反规则的包裹：出仓口径下为出仓扫描晚于当日生效的截止时点；签收口径下为按时出仓但 POD 落在 Day 窗口之外。源数据尚无包裹级明细，当前列表为基于单元格推导的确定性样本——同一单元格始终返回相同包裹，比率越差列表越长。接入数仓查询即可转为真实明细。' } },2593      ],2594    };2595    <\/script>25962597    <section class="rpt rpt--spx">2598      <div class="rpt__head">2599 if (!b) return;3303        draft.level = b.getAttribute('data-l');3304        var d = LEVELS.indexOf(draft.level);      // drop any filter deeper than the new level3305        if (d < 1) draft.sc = '';3306        if (d < 2) draft.fleet = '';3307        if (d < 3) draft.driver = '';3308        paintSeg(); syncFilters(draft, ids); if (cfg.onLevel) cfg.onLevel(); dirty();3309      });3310      if (ids.daySeg) {3311        document.getElementById(ids.daySeg).addEventListener('click', function(ev){3312          var b = ev.target.closest('.seg__btn'); if (!b) return;3313          draft.day = b.getAttribute('data-d');3314          paintSeg(); dirty();3315        });3316      }3317      [['region', ids.region], ['sc', ids.sc], ['fleet', ids.fleet], ['driver', ids.driver]].forEach(function(p){3318        document.getElementById(p[1]).addEventListener('change', function(){3319          draft[p[0]] = this.value;3320          if (p[0] === 'region') { draft.sc = ''; draft.fleet = ''; draft.driver = ''; }3321          if (p[0] === 'sc')     { draft.fleet = ''; draft.driver = ''; }3322          if (p[0] === 'fleet')  { draft.driver = ''; }3323          syncFilters(draft, ids); dirty();3324        });3325      });3326      ok.addEventListener('click', function(){3327        STAGED_KEYS.forEach(function(k){ if (draft[k] !== undefined) live[k] = draft[k]; });3328        dirty(); cfg.render();3329      });3330      no.addEventListener('click', function(){3331        STAGED_KEYS.forEach(function(k){ if (draft[k] !== undefined) draft[k] = live[k]; });3332        paintSeg(); syncFilters(draft, ids);3333        if (cfg.onCancel) cfg.onCancel();3334        dirty();3335      });3336      dirty();          // start clean — both buttons hidden3337      return dirty;3338    }33393340    var ofdIds = { seg:'ofdLvl', region:'ofdRegion', sc:'ofdSc', fleet:'ofdFleet', driver:'ofdDriver',3341                   apply:'ofdApply', cancel:'ofdCancel' };3342    var podIds = { seg:'podLvl', daySeg:'podDay', region:'podRegion', sc:'podSc', fleet:'podFleet', driver:'podDriver',3343                   apply:'podApply', cancel:'podCancel' };33443345    function init(){3346      /* One picker range for every level, because there is one column axis for3347         every level. A level change therefore does NOT touch the date range:3348         drilling from region to SC keeps whatever nine days (or whatever the3349         reader narrowed it to) were on screen, which is the only way the two3350         views are comparable. This used to reset on every level change, and had3351         to — the window itself changed underneath. */3352      function paintOfdRange(){3353        var avail = DATES_REGION, keys = avail.map(iso);3354        var s = document.getElementById('ofdStart'), e = document.getElementById('ofdEnd');3355        if (ofdDraft.end > avail.length-1) ofdDraft.end = avail.length-1;3356        if (ofdDraft.start > ofdDraft.end) ofdDraft.start = defStart(avail);3357        s.min = e.min = keys[0]; s.max = e.max = keys[keys.length-1];3358        s.value = keys[ofdDraft.start]; e.value = keys[ofdDraft.end];3359      }3360      var ofdDirty = bindStaged({ draft:ofdDraft, live:ofdLive, ids:ofdIds, render:renderOfd,3361                                  onCancel: paintOfdRange });3362      var podDirty = bindStaged({ draft:podDraft, live:podLive, ids:podIds, render:renderPod,3363                                  onCancel: function(){ paintPodRange(); } });33643365      function stageRange(draft, avail, sId, eId, repaint, dirty){3366        var keys = avail.map(iso);3367        var si = keys.indexOf(document.getElementById(sId).value);3368        var ei = keys.indexOf(document.getElementById(eId).value);3369        if (si < 0) si = 0;3370        if (ei < 0) ei = keys.length-1;3371        if (si > ei) { var t = si; si = ei; ei = t; }3372        draft.start = si; draft.end = ei; repaint(); dirty();3373      }3374      document.getElementById('ofdStart').addEventListener('change', function(){3375        stageRange(ofdDraft, DATES_REGION, 'ofdStart', 'ofdEnd', paintOfdRange, ofdDirty);3376      });3377      document.getElementById('ofdEnd').addEventListener('change', function(){3378        stageRange(ofdDraft, DATES_REGION, 'ofdStart', 'ofdEnd', paintOfdRange, ofdDirty);3379      });3380      paintOfdRange();33813382      var podKeys = DATES_REGION.map(iso);3383      function paintPodRange(){3384        var s = document.getElementById('podStart'), e = document.getElementById('podEnd');3385        s.min = e.min = podKeys[0]; s.max = e.max = podKeys[podKeys.length-1];3386        s.value = podKeys[podDraft.start]; e.value = podKeys[podDraft.end];3387      }3388      document.getElementById('podStart').addEventListener('change', function(){3389        stageRange(podDraft, DATES_REGION, 'podStart', 'podEnd', paintPodRange, podDirty);3390      });3391      document.getElementById('podEnd').addEventListener('change', function(){3392        stageRange(podDraft, DATES_REGION, 'podStart', 'podEnd', paintPodRange, podDirty);3393      });3394      paintPodRange();33953396      // Export is always WYSIWYG — it writes the live table exactly as rendered.3397      function dl(id, file, sheet, title){3398        if (!window.SPXExport) { alert(T('Export module not ready.','导出模块未就绪。')); return; }3399        window.SPXExport.downloadTable(document.getElementById(id), file, { sheetName:sheet, title:title });3400      }3401      document.getElementById('ofdDl').addEventListener('click', function(){3402        var d = DATES_REGION;3403        dl('ofdTable', 'on_time_ofd_rate_'+ofdLive.level+'_'+d[ofdLive.start]+'-'+d[ofdLive.end]+'.xlsx',3404           'On-time OFD Rate', T('On-time OFD Rate','出仓及时率'));3405      });3406      document.getElementById('podDl').addEventListener('click', function(){3407        dl('podTable',3408           'on_time_delivery_rate_'+podLive.level+'_'+DATES_REGION[podLive.start]+'-'+DATES_REGION[podLive.end]+'.xlsx',3409           'On-time Delivery Rate', T('On-time Delivery Rate','及时签收率'));3410      });34113412      document.getElementById('ofdTable').addEventListener('click', function(ev){3413        var td = ev.target.closest('td.is-drill'); if (!td) return;3414        openDetail(OFD_DRILL[+td.getAttribute('data-k')]);3415      });3416      document.getElementById('podTable').addEventListener('click', function(ev){3417        var td = ev.target.closest('td.is-drill'); if (!td) return;3418        openDetail(POD_DRILL[+td.getAttribute('data-k')]);3419      });34203421      syncFilters(ofdDraft, ofdIds); syncFilters(podDraft, podIds);3422      renderOfd(); renderPod();3423      if (window.SPXPortal && SPXPortal.resizableColumns) {3424        SPXPortal.resizableColumns(document.getElementById('ofdTable'));3425        SPXPortal.resizableColumns(document.getElementById('podTable'));3426      }3427      (window.__spxOnLang = window.__spxOnLang || []).push(function(){3428        syncFilters(ofdDraft, ofdIds); syncFilters(podDraft, podIds); renderOfd(); renderPod();3429      });3430    }3431    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);3432    else init();3433  })();3434  <\/script>3435</body>3436</html>34373438</script>3439<script type="text/markdown" id="doc-qc-ofd-trend">3440# 出仓报表 · 趋势 · 开发说明34413442考核 **SC 自身的派送能力**。包裹已经到站，只剩两件事：**能不能按时发出去**（出仓及时率）、3443**能不能按时送到**（及时签收 Day 1 / Day 2）。干线晚到、分拣积压等上游因素不在口径内。3444它是网管与司机能力考核里优先级最高、也最先落地的一块，后续考核项复用这里的层级、3445责任人与配置版本化三件事。34463447本页 = 一段时间聚合在**天**上看，回答「哪天、哪个实体不对劲」。3448「单日」= 某一天摊在小时上，回答「那天几点钟出的问题」。3449两页都必须同时有出仓及时率与及时签收率；本页不做按小时的列。34503451---34523453## 前端34543455### 两张表34563457| 区域 | 指标 | 行 | 列 |3458|---|---|---|---|3459| 上 | 出仓及时率 | 当前层级的实体 | 所选区间每一天 + 吸底合计行 |3460| 下 | 及时签收率 | 同上 | 同上，每天拆 Day 1 / Day 2 两列 |34613462两张表各自独立筛选、各自独立日期区间。两张表都可下钻，不做只能看大区的表。34633464### 层级与身份列34653466层级 = **大区 › SC › 车队 › 司机**，默认大区。身份列随层级变化：34673468| 层级 | 身份列 |3469|---|---|3470| 大区 | 大区 · RGM · Owner |3471| SC | 大区 · SC · SC Manager · Owner |3472| 车队 | 大区 · SC · 车队 |3473| 司机 | 大区 · SC · 车队 · 司机 |34743475- RGM / SC Manager = 运营线（谁在跑），Owner = 数字责任人（出问题找谁），两列不合并。3476- 车队与司机不设人列：车队是 SC 的人之下的供应商，司机本身即责任人。3477- 人名列左对齐，其余身份列居中。3478- 人名列是展示列**不是层级**：下钻、明细查询、导出文件名只读 `[大区, SC, 车队, 司机]`。3479- `Owner` 对应「本地人员与映射 › 大区」里的哪个角色**尚未确定**，定下来之前不要接到那一页的任何一列。34803481### 日期区间34823483- 默认 = **从昨天往前数九天到昨天**（D-9 … D-1），两张表都是，四个层级都是。3484- **不含当天**：当日是未完结批次，比率会涨到当天结束。3485- **不是"全部"**：区间必须是固定天数，否则表宽随源序列增长。3486- **四个层级共用同一条日期轴，切层级不改变区间。** 只有那两个日期控件能改区间，层级按钮不能。3487- 日期列头带**周几**；周六、周日的表头单元格换暖色底，只染表头不染整列。34883489### 控件34903491- 层级、筛选、日期区间、Day 开关全部**草稿态**：`change` 只写草稿，点「确认」才生效并重渲染。3492- 「确认 / 取消」在草稿与视图一致时隐藏，任一控件被动过时成对出现。3493- 层级往上收时，比新层级更深的筛选值清空。34943495### 目标值34963497不做成列，改为**悬停在数值格上**显示该格按当日生效版本解析出的规则：34983499| 指标 | 悬停文案 |3500|---|---|3501| 出仓及时率 | `Target · by 09:00 ≥ 90.00%`（截止时点是业务变量，写完整规则） |3502| 及时签收率 | `Target · Day 1 ≥ 97.00%`（只写阈值；截止时点恒为 23:59，Day 1 在 D+0、Day 2 在 D+1） |35033504仅当某版本的签收截止时点不是 23:59 时才补印时点。悬停文案不可点击、不参与着色。35053506### 下钻35073508每个数值单元格可点，打开该格的未达标包裹明细：运单号 · SC · 出仓时间 · 车队 · 司机 · 签收时间。35093510| 点的是 | 范围 | 未达标定义 |3511|---|---|---|3512| 比率格 | 该实体 × 该日 | 见下 |3513| 出仓表的行首身份格 | 该实体 × 当前可见的整个区间 | 出仓口径 |35143515- 出仓口径：出仓扫描晚于**当日生效**的截止时点。3516- 签收口径：按时出仓，但 POD 落在该档窗口之外。3517- 弹窗标题跟着**点的那一列**换，不跟着页面换。35183519### 渲染35203521- 着色：≥ 目标值 → 浅绿底，< 目标值 → 浅红底，无值 → 不着色。**文字颜色一律不变。**3522- 判定用**该日期当日生效**的目标值。3523- 合计行取标题栏深蓝底、白字，吸底固定，底色不透明；**不带达标着色**。3524  它取全网加权口径而非可见行均值，因此**任一筛选生效即隐藏**。3525- 行高 22px 一档；列宽由内容决定，单元格左右内边距 6px。3526- 列宽可拖动：拖表头右边缘。未拖动前自动布局；拖动中只有一条参考线跟随，松手才应用并转为3527  固定布局（固定布局下列宽可小于文字宽度，文字省略号截断）。宽度按**表头文案**记住，3528  重渲染不丢，**不写 localStorage**。跨两列的表头拖它覆盖的最后一列；同名列一起变。3529- 标题栏用 SpeedX 深蓝 `#1A2872`，`<thead>` 用浅色带，两者不同色。3530- 筛选控件与表标题同一行：标题居左，控件靠右，放不下时换行。35313532### 导出35333534WYSIWYG `.xlsx` = 当前屏幕上的表，带当前层级、筛选、Day 开关、日期区间。按钮在表标题旁。35353536---35373538## 数据35393540### 定义35413542两个指标**共用同一个批次**：日期 D 的批次 = 当日出仓的包裹，分母相同。35433544| 指标 | 分子 |3545|---|---|3546| 出仓及时率 | OFD 扫描早于当日生效截止时点（默认 09:00） |3547| 及时签收率 Day 1 | 在 D 当日 23:59 前完成签收 |3548| 及时签收率 Day 2 | 在 D+1 当日 23:59 前完成签收（**累计**，含 Day 1） |35493550验收点：355135521. **Day 2 ≥ Day 1 恒成立**（同批次、累计口径）。35532. 出仓与签收不能相互推导、不能相加：分母同、分子不同，两条独立判定。35543. 同一范围同一天，本页的 Day 1 / Day 2 必须与「单日」逐格相同——两页调**同一个接口**，不各自算。35553556### 空值与零值35573558任何单元格只有三种可能：35593560| 情况 | 显示 | 参与判定 | 可下钻 |3561|---|---|---|---|3562| 分母有值、分子有值 | 比率 | 是 | 是 |3563| 分母有值、分子为 0（有批次，一件都没达成） | `0.00%` | 是（必然未达标，红） | 是 |3564| 分母为 0（当天该范围没有批次） | **留空** | 否 | 否 |35653566- 「没有批次」显示成 `0.00%` = 凭空造一个红格。3567- 「一件都没达成」显示成空白 = 藏掉一次最严重的失败。3568- 上卷时分母为 0 的实体**不进分母**，不能当成 0% 拉低上一级。35693570### 需要的字段35713572| 字段 | 用途 |3573|---|---|3574| 运单号 | 明细下钻 |3575| OFD 扫描时间，**站点本地时区** | 划批次 + 出仓及时率分子 |3576| 签收时间 POD，**站点本地时区** | 签收两档分子 |3577| 大区 / SC / 车队 / 司机 | 四层行维度 |3578| 大区 RGM、大区 Owner | 身份列（仅大区级） |3579| SC Manager、SC Owner | 身份列（仅 SC 级）。**SC Manager 数仓目前没有这个字段，需要补** |35803581时区必须用站点当地时间，否则跨零点的包裹会被系统性算错。35823583### 聚合35843585- **每一层按该层自己的分子分母直接算**，不许用下一级比率的算术平均——各实体件量不同，3586  均值会放大小站的极端值。3587- 合计行 = 全网加权 `Σ分子 ÷ Σ分母`。3588- 网络合计**只有一条序列**，四个层级共用同一个值。35893590### 配置35913592来自「配置 › 出仓报表配置」，两套规则都读：35933594- **出仓**：截止时点 + 目标值，按生效日版本化。3595- **签收**：Day 1 / Day 2 两条**独立时间线**，各自的目标值与生效日；**同档内解析**，3596  跨档取会让一条规则被不相干的变更提前结束。35973598取某日期的生效规则 = 生效日 ≤ 该日期的最后一条。每个日期列各自按当日生效版本判定，3599**改配置不改写历史**。36003601### 明细查询36023603按单元格的（层级路径, 日期范围, 指标/档位）拉包裹级明细，必须限量 + 分页。36043605### 刷新36063607近实时。当日为未完结批次，数值涨到当天结束；签收 Day 2 到 D+1 结束才定型。3608最新一列（签收为最近两列）不是终值。36093610</script>3611<script type="text/html" id="mod-qc-ofd-single-day">3612<!DOCTYPE html>3613<html lang="en" data-theme="light">3614<head>3615  <meta charset="UTF-8" />3616  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" src="../../assets/portal.js" data-portal data-depth="2" defer><\/script>3621  <script src="../../assets/xlsx-export.js" defer><\/script>3622</head>3623<body>3624  <div class="main-inner">36253626    <header class="page-header">3627      <div class="page-header__main">3628        <span class="eyebrow" data-t data-en="Out for Delivery Report" data-zh="出仓报表">Out for Delivery Report</span>3629        <h1 class="page-title" data-t data-en="Single Day" data-zh="单日">Single Day</h1>3630      </div>3631      <div class="page-header__actions"></div>3632    </header>36333634    <script>3635    window.REPORT_INFO = {3636      category: { en:'Out for Delivery Report', zh:'出仓报表' },3637      title:    { en:'Single Day', zh:'单日' },3638      purpose: {3639        en:'One day of a delivery station’s own performance, read left to right: how much went out and how many drivers carried it, then the day’s three verdicts — On-time Delivery Day 1 and Day 2, then On-time OFD — then the same day’s out-for-delivery scanning spread across the 24 hours it happened in. This report scores the SC’s OWN delivery capability; upstream linehaul and sortation are deliberately out of scope. Opens on YESTERDAY, the newest closed day, for both tables. The upper table is the region view; the lower one takes the same day down to SC, Fleet or Driver. The same two metrics day over day are in Trend.',3640        zh:'一个站点某一天的派送表现，从左往右读：当日出仓多少件、多少名司机在跑，然后是当日三项判定——及时签收 Day 1 与 Day 2，再是出仓及时率，再往右是当日出仓扫描在 24 个小时上的分布。本报表考核的是 SC 自己的派送能力，上游的发车与分拣不在考核范围内。两张表默认都是昨天，即最近一个已完结的日期。上表为大区视角，下表把同一天下钻至 SC、车队或司机。这两项指标的按日期趋势见「趋势」。',3641      },3642      ownership: [3643        { kind:'danger', en:'Quality Control', zh:'质量控制' },3644        { kind:'brand',  en:'Regional Operations', zh:'大区运营' },3645      ],3646      refresh: { en:'Near real-time', zh:'近实时' },3647      concepts: [3648        { term:{ en:'On-time OFD Rate', zh:'出仓及时率' },3649          desc:{ en:'OFD = out for delivery. For a date D the cohort is every parcel that went out for delivery on D — that is the DENOMINATOR. The NUMERATOR is the subset whose OFD scan landed before the configured cut-off clock (09:00 local by default). Rate = numerator ÷ denominator. Two configuration inputs drive it: the cut-off time and the target (90%).',3650                 zh:'OFD 即 out for delivery（出仓）。对日期 D，批次为当日所有出仓包裹，即分母；分子为其中出仓扫描发生在配置的截止时点（默认当地 09:00）之前的包裹。及时率 = 分子 ÷ 分母。由两项配置驱动：截止时点与目标值（90%）。' } },3651        { term:{ en:'On-time Delivery Rate', zh:'及时签收率' },3652          desc:{ en:'Same cohort, same denominator as the OFD metric: every parcel that went out for delivery on this date. Day 1 is the share of that cohort with a POD by the end of the day itself; Day 2 is the CUMULATIVE share with a POD by the end of the next day. Because Day 2 is cumulative over the same cohort, Day 2 is never below Day 1. Day 2 is only final after the next day closes.',3653                 zh:'与出仓及时率同批次、同分母：当日出仓的全部包裹。Day 1 为该批次在当日结束前完成签收（POD）的占比；Day 2 为截至次日结束的累计签收占比。由于 Day 2 是同一批次的累计口径，Day 2 恒不低于 Day 1。Day 2 要到次日结束才定型。' } },3654        { term:{ en:'Package Volume', zh:'出仓件量' },3655          desc:{ en:'The parcel count that went out for delivery on this date for that row — the DENOMINATOR every rate on the row is computed over. It is here because a rate without its parcel count is unreadable: 100% on 40 parcels and 91% on 40,000 are not comparable, and the row that deserves attention is usually the large one.',3656                 zh:'该行当日出仓的包裹件数——本行所有比率共用的分母。放在这里的理由是：不带件量的比率无法判断轻重，40 件的 100% 与 4 万件的 91% 不是一回事，值得先看的往往是大的那个。' } },3657        { term:{ en:'Drivers', zh:'司机数' },3658          desc:{ en:'How many drivers took parcels out for delivery on this date within that row’s scope. Read together with Package Volume it says whether a bad rate is a staffing problem or a process one; at driver level it is always 1.',3659                 zh:'该行范围内当日有出仓的司机人数。与出仓件量一起读，可区分一个差比率是排班问题还是流程问题；司机层级恒为 1。' } },3660        { term:{ en:'Hourly share', zh:'分时段占比' },3661          desc:{ en:'Each hour column is that hour’s SHARE of the day’s out-for-delivery volume, so a row sums to 100%. The columns up to the cut-off add up to the cumulative figure scored against the target; everything to the right of the cut-off is what missed it and how late.',3662                 zh:'每个小时列为该小时出仓量占当日出仓总量的占比，整行合计为 100%。截止时点之前的各列合计即用于对照目标值的累计值；截止时点右侧的部分即未达标的量及其迟出程度。' } },3663        { term:{ en:'On-time OFD (by cut-off)', zh:'出仓及时率（截止时点前累计）' },3664          desc:{ en:'The share out the door by the cut-off clock in force that day — the same number Trend scores for this date. It equals the sum of the hour columns up to the cut-off, which is why it sits immediately to the left of them.',3665                 zh:'当日生效的截止时点之前的累计出仓占比，与「趋势」对该日期判定的是同一个数值。它等于截止时点之前各小时列之和，因此紧挨在小时列左侧。' } },3666        { term:{ en:'Which cells carry a verdict', zh:'哪些格子带达标判定' },3667          desc:{ en:'Three: On-time OFD, Day 1 and Day 2, each against its own target for this date. Package Volume and Drivers are counts, not rates, and are never scored. The hour columns are a distribution, not a verdict — a busy hour is not a failing hour.',3668                 zh:'三个：出仓及时率、Day 1、Day 2，各自对照该日期生效的目标值。出仓件量与司机数是计数不是比率，不参与判定。小时列是分布不是判定——某小时量大并不等于该小时不达标。' } },3669        { term:{ en:'Levels', zh:'层级' },3670          desc:{ en:'Region › SC › Fleet › Driver. The hierarchy is real — these are the SCs and fleets that actually serve each region. Coverage is not: On-time OFD is reported at region and fleet level, so SC rows are the mean of the fleets serving that SC and driver rows are a modelled roster around the fleet rate. On-time Delivery is reported at region level only, so everything below it is modelled around the region’s reported Day 1 / Day 2. Package Volume and Drivers are not in the source extract at all and are modelled top-down. Swap all of them in as soon as the warehouse publishes them.',3671                 zh:'大区 › SC › 车队 › 司机。层级本身是真实的——即各大区实际服务的 SC 与车队；覆盖度则不然：出仓及时率的源数据到大区与车队两级，因此 SC 行取该 SC 下各车队的均值，司机行为围绕车队值推导的名册；及时签收率仅有大区级源数据，其下各级均围绕该大区的 Day 1 / Day 2 推导；出仓件量与司机数源数据里完全没有，为自上而下推导。数仓发布后即可全部替换为真实值。' } },3672        { term:{ en:'Owner', zh:'负责人' },3673          desc:{ en:'Carried at region and SC level, where one person answers for the number. A fleet is a vendor operating under the SC’s owner, and a driver is the accountable party already, so neither carries the column.',3674                 zh:'仅在大区与 SC 两级显示——这两级各有一位对该数字负责的人。车队为在该 SC 负责人之下作业的供应商，司机本身即责任人，故两级均不设该列。' } },3675        { term:{ en:'Date coverage', zh:'日期覆盖' },3676          desc:{ en:'The reported region series runs longer than the fleet-level source, so the day picker narrows when the table is taken below region level, and widens again on the way back up.',3677                 zh:'大区级上报序列比车队级源数据更长，因此表格下钻到大区以下时可选日期范围会收窄，返回大区级时恢复。' } },3678        { term:{ en:'Config resolution', zh:'配置口径' },3679          desc:{ en:'Every rule comes from Configuration › Out for Delivery Report Configuration, versioned by effective date: the OFD cut-off clock and its target, and a separate Day 1 and Day 2 target. A report date is always scored against the version in force on that date, so changing a rule never rewrites history. Read a rule off a value cell — hovering one shows what that cell was scored against. The OFD rule spells itself out in full ("by 09:00 ≥ 90.00%") because the cut-off clock is a business variable; the delivery rule shows the threshold only ("Day 1 ≥ 97.00%"), because its closing clock is always 23:59.',3680                 zh:'所有规则均取自“配置 › 出仓报表配置”，按生效日期版本化：出仓截止时点与其目标值，以及 Day 1、Day 2 各自独立的目标值。任一报表日期始终按当日生效的版本计算，调整规则不会改写历史数据。把鼠标停在任一数值格上即显示该格所依据的规则：出仓口径写完整规则（“09:00 前 ≥ 90.00%”），因为截止时点是业务变量；签收口径只写阈值（“Day 1 ≥ 97.00%”），因为其截止时点恒为 23:59。' } },3681        { term:{ en:'Miss detail', zh:'未达标明细' },3682          desc:{ en:'A miss is a parcel in that cell’s cohort that broke that cell’s rule: for On-time OFD its scan landed after the cut-off in force that day; for Day 1 / Day 2 it left on time but its POD landed outside the Day window. Drilling an hour column returns the parcels that left in that hour, and an hour that closes before the cut-off has none. Parcel-level rows are not in the source workbook yet, so the list is a deterministic sample derived from the cell — the same cell always returns the same parcels. Point it at the warehouse query to make it live.',3683                 zh:'未达标即该单元格批次中违反该格规则的包裹：出仓及时率下为出仓扫描晚于当日生效的截止时点；Day 1 / Day 2 下为按时出仓但 POD 落在该档窗口之外。下钻某个小时列返回该小时出仓的包裹，截止时点之前结束的小时不含未达标包裹。源数据尚无包裹级明细，当前列表为基于单元格推导的确定性样本——同一单元格始终返回相同包裹。接入数仓查询即可转为真实明细。' } },3684      ],3685    };3686    <\/script>36873688    <section class="rpt rpt--spx">3689 draft.fleet = ''; draft.driver = ''; }4397            if (p[0] === 'sc')     { draft.fleet = ''; draft.driver = ''; }4398            if (p[0] === 'fleet')  { draft.driver = ''; }4399            syncFilters(draft, ids); });4409        paintSeg(); syncFilters(draft, ids);4410        if (cfg.onCancel) cfg.onCancel();4411        dirty();4412      });4413      dirty();          // start clean — both buttons hidden4414      return dirty;4415    }44164417    var regIds = { apply:'rApply', cancel:'rCancel' };4418    var brkIds = { seg:'bLvl', region:'bRegion', sc:'bSc', fleet:'bFleet', driver:'bDriver',4419                   apply:'bApply', cancel:'bCancel' };44204421    function init(){4422      /* No per-level day clamp any more. clamp4425         moved it, the two tables ended up on different days, and a draft that4426         disagreed with the view on load made Confirm / Cancel appear unprompted.4427         Every level now covers the same nine days, so there is nothing to clamp4428         and nothing to disagree about. */4429      function painter(draft, inputId){4430        return function(){4431          var avail = 自身的派送能力**。包裹已经到站，只剩两件事：**能不能按时发出去**（出仓及时率）、4500**能不能按时送到**（及时签收 Day 1 / Day 2）。干线晚到、分拣积压等上游因素不在口径内。4501它是网管与司机能力考核里优先级最高、也最先落地的一块，后续考核项复用这里的层级、4502责任人与配置版本化三件事。45034504本页 = 某一天摊在小时上，回答「那天几点钟出的问题」。4505「趋势」= 一段时间聚合在天上看，回答「哪天、哪个实体不对劲」。4506两页都必须同时有出仓及时率与及时签收率；本页不做按日期的表。45074508---45094510## 前端45114512### 两张表45134514上下两张表，**列结构完全相同**，只差层级：45154516| 表 | 层级 |4517|---|---|4518| 上 · 按大区 | 固定大区，无层级选择器、无筛选下拉 |4519| 下 · 下钻 | 可选大区 / SC / 车队 / 司机，默认 **SC** |45204521两张表各自独立选日期。45224523### 列45244525顺序 = **规模 → 结果 → 原因 → 分布**：45264527| 列 | 分组表头 | 内容 |4528|---|---|---|4529| 身份列 | — | 随层级变化，见下 |4530| 出仓件量 | — | 当日出仓包裹**件数**，本行所有比率共用的分母 |4531| 司机数 | — | 当日有出仓的司机人数；司机层级恒为 1 |4532| Day 1 / Day 2 | 及时签收率 | 同批次的签收占比 |4533| 出仓及时率 | — | 出仓扫描早于当日生效截止时点的占比 |4534| 00:00-01:00 … 23:00-24:00 | 分时段出仓占比 | 该小时出仓量占当日出仓总量的占比，整行合计 100% |45354536- **表头两行**：身份列、件量、司机数、出仓及时率跨两行；「及时签收率」跨两列；4537  「分时段出仓占比」跨 24 列。4538- **及时签收在出仓及时率前面**：签收是要考核的结果，出仓及时率是站点对这个结果的上游贡献。4539- **出仓及时率紧挨小时列**，它就是那些列里截止时点之前那一段之和，中间不插别的列。4540- **件量与司机数是计数不是比率**：不着色、不参与达标判定、不可下钻。4541- 小时列头写**完整区间** `00:00-01:00`，不用 `0-1` / `00–01`。45424543### 层级与身份列45444545层级 = **大区 › SC › 车队 › 司机**。身份列随层级变化：45464547| 层级 | 身份列 |4548|---|---|4549| 大区 | 大区 · RGM · Owner |4550| SC | 大区 · SC · SC Manager · Owner |4551| 车队 | 大区 · SC · 车队 |4552| 司机 | 大区 · SC · 车队 · 司机 |45534554- RGM / SC Manager = 运营线（谁在跑），Owner = 数字责任人（出问题找谁），两列不合并。4555- 车队与司机不设人列：车队是 SC 的人之下的供应商，司机本身即责任人。4556- 人名列左对齐，其余身份列居中。4557- 人名列是展示列**不是层级**：下钻、明细查询、导出文件名只读 `[大区, SC, 车队, 司机]`。4558- `Owner` 对应「本地人员与映射 › 大区」里的哪个角色**尚未确定**，定下来之前不要接到那一页的任何一列。45594560### 日期45614562- 默认 = **昨天（D-1）**，两张表都是。4563- **不含当天**：当日靠后的小时格还在填，比率还在涨。4564- **可选日期在四个层级完全相同**，切层级不拿走任何一天。4565- 日期控件旁显示**周几**。4566- Day 2 在默认日期上按定义还没定型（要到 D+1 结束才封板），它是一个还在涨的中间值。45674568### 控件45694570- 层级、筛选、日期全部**草稿态**：`change` 只写草稿，点「确认」才生效并重渲染。4571- 「确认 / 取消」在草稿与视图一致时隐藏，任一控件被动过时成对出现。4572- 层级往上收时，比新层级更深的筛选值清空。45734574### 目标值45754576不做成列，改为**悬停在判定格上**显示该格按当日生效版本解析出的规则：45774578| 判定格 | 悬停文案 |4579|---|---|4580| 出仓及时率 | `Target · by 09:00 ≥ 90.00%`（截止时点是业务变量，写完整规则） |4581| Day 1 / Day 2 | `Target · Day 1 ≥ 97.00%`（只写阈值；截止时点恒为 23:59，不可配置） |45824583### 下钻45844585出仓及时率、Day 1、Day 2 与每个小时格可点，打开该格的未达标包裹明细：4586运单号 · SC · 出仓时间 · 车队 · 司机 · 签收时间。件量与司机数不可点。45874588| 点的是 | 范围 | 未达标定义 |4589|---|---|---|4590| 出仓及时率 | 该实体 × 该日 | 出仓扫描晚于当日生效的截止时点 |4591| 小时格 | 该实体 × 该日 × **该小时内出仓**的包裹 | 同上 |4592| Day 1 / Day 2 | 该实体 × 该日 × 该档 | 按时出仓，但 POD 落在该档窗口之外 |45934594- 截止时点**之前**结束的小时按定义没有未达标包裹，下钻结果为空。4595- 弹窗标题跟着**点的那一列**换（出仓 / 签收），不跟着页面换。45964597### 渲染45984599- 着色只作用于**三个判定格**（Day 1 · Day 2 · 出仓及时率）：≥ 目标值 → 浅绿底，4600  < 目标值 → 浅红底，无值 → 不着色。**文字颜色一律不变。** 三个格各按自己的目标值判定。4601- 小时格用**中性的品牌色深浅**表示占比高低，按当前表内最大值归一。它是分布不是判定，4602  **不许用红绿**。4603- 合计行取标题栏深蓝底、白字，吸底固定；**不带达标着色**。它取全网口径而非可见行汇总，4604  因此**任一筛选生效即隐藏**。4605- 行高 22px 一档；列宽由内容决定，单元格左右内边距 6px。4606- 列宽可拖动：拖表头右边缘。未拖动前自动布局；拖动中只有一条参考线跟随，松手才应用并转为4607  固定布局（固定布局下列宽可小于文字宽度，文字省略号截断）。宽度按**表头文案**记住，4608  重渲染不丢，**不写 localStorage**。跨多列的分组表头不带手柄，拖它覆盖的各列表头。4609- 标题栏用 SpeedX 深蓝 `#1A2872`，`<thead>` 用浅色带，两者不同色。4610- 筛选控件与表标题同一行：标题居左，控件靠右，放不下时换行。46114612### 导出46134614WYSIWYG `.xlsx` = 当前屏幕上的表，带当前层级、筛选、日期。两张表各自一个按钮，在表标题旁。46154616---46174618## 数据46194620### 定义46214622日期 D 的批次 = **当日出仓的包裹**。这一行上每个比率共用这一个分母，即「出仓件量」那一列。46234624| 数值 | 定义 |4625|---|---|4626| 出仓件量 | 该批次的件数，`COUNT(DISTINCT 运单号)` |4627| 司机数 | 该批次里出现过的不同司机数，`COUNT(DISTINCT 司机)`（不是排班表人数） |4628| 及时签收 Day 1 | 该批次在 **D 当日 23:59** 前完成签收的占比 |4629| 及时签收 Day 2 | 该批次在 **D+1 当日 23:59** 前完成签收的占比（**累计**，含 Day 1） |4630| 出仓及时率 | 出仓扫描早于当日生效截止时点（默认 09:00）的占比 |4631| 小时 h 的格子 | 出仓扫描落在 `[h:00, h+1:00)` 的占比 |46324633验收点：463446351. 一行 24 个小时格**合计 = 100%**；截止时点之前各小时格之和 **= 出仓及时率**。46362. **Day 2 ≥ Day 1 恒成立**（同批次、累计口径）。46373. **每一级件量之和 = 上一级件量**：司机 → 车队 → SC → 大区 → 合计行。46384. 出仓与签收不能相互推导、不能相加：分母同、分子不同，三条独立判定。46395. 同一范围同一天，本页的 Day 1 / Day 2 必须与「趋势」逐格相同——两页调**同一个接口**，不各自算。46404641### 空值与零值46424643比率的任何单元格只有三种可能：46444645| 情况 | 显示 | 参与判定 | 可下钻 |4646|---|---|---|---|4647| 分母有值、分子有值 | 比率 | 是 | 是 |4648| 分母有值、分子为 0（有批次，一件都没达成） | `0.00%` | 是（必然未达标，红） | 是 |4649| 分母为 0（当天该范围没有批次） | **留空** | 否 | 否 |46504651- 「没有批次」显示成 `0.00%` = 凭空造一个红格。4652- 「一件都没达成」显示成空白 = 藏掉一次最严重的失败。4653- 上卷时分母为 0 的实体**不进分母**。4654- **件量与司机数不走这张表**：它们是计数，`0` 照实写 `0`。件量为 0 的那一行，4655  三个比率必须全部留空。46564657### 需要的字段46584659| 字段 | 用途 |4660|---|---|4661| 运单号 | 明细下钻 + 件量计数 |4662| OFD 扫描时间，**站点本地时区** | 划批次 + 分小时归桶 + 出仓及时率分子 |4663| 签收时间 POD，**站点本地时区** | 签收两档分子 |4664| 大区 / SC / 车队 / 司机 | 四层行维度 + 司机数 |4665| 大区 RGM、大区 Owner | 身份列（仅大区级） |4666| SC Manager、SC Owner | 身份列（仅 SC 级）。**SC Manager 数仓目前没有这个字段，需要补** |46674668分小时归桶必须用**站点当地时间**。用 UTC 归桶会把整条出仓曲线按时区整体平移，4669东西岸的站点被移到不同小时上，图形完全失真。46704671### 聚合46724673- **比率**：每一层按该层自己的分子分母直接算。不许用下一级比率的算术平均，4674  也不许用大区的小时分布去套下级——出仓曲线逐站不同，一个 SC 的排班早两小时，4675  套大区曲线就把它最重要的特征抹掉了。4676- **件量**：必须严格自下而上可加（见验收点 3）。4677- **司机数**：按该级去重计数。司机跨 SC 作业时去重人数会小于各级相加，这是唯一允许不相加的列。4678- 合计行 = 比率取全网加权 `Σ分子 ÷ Σ分母`，件量与司机数取全网计数，不是可见行之和。46794680### 配置46814682来自「配置 › 出仓报表配置」，两套规则都读：46834684- **出仓**：截止时点 + 目标值，按生效日版本化。截止时点同时决定两件事——出仓及时率算到哪一列为止，4685  以及小时格下钻是否返回未达标包裹。4686- **签收**：Day 1 / Day 2 两条**独立时间线**，各自的目标值与生效日；**同档内解析**，4687  跨档取会让一条规则被不相干的变更提前结束。46884689取某日期的生效规则 = 生效日 ≤ 该日期的最后一条。**改配置不改写历史。**46904691### 明细查询46924693按单元格的（层级路径, 日期, 指标/档位, 小时区间或全天）拉包裹级明细，必须限量 + 分页。46944695- 出仓口径条件带：出仓扫描时间 > 当日生效截止时点。4696- 签收口径条件带：POD 晚于该档窗口或为空。46974698### 刷新46994700近实时。当日为未完结批次，靠后的小时格填到当天结束，出仓及时率同步上涨；4701Day 2 到 D+1 结束才定型。47024703</script>4704<script A reader handed a v24840    // payload would quietly resolve undefined targets, so the key moves with it.4841    var POD_KEY = 'ofd-report-delivery-v3', OFD_KEY = 'ofd-report-cutoff-v2';4842    var pod = load(POD_KEY, podSeed);4843    var ofd = load(OFD_KEY, ofdSeed);48444845    /* ---- effective windows ----4846       Effective To is DERIVED, never entered: a row runs until the day before4847       the next row on the same timeline, and the newest row stays open. There is deliberately no "version" number: the4850       effective date is the only handle a rule has. */4851    var TODAY = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);4852    function pad(n){ return n < 10 ? '0'+n : ''+n; }4853    function dayBefore(s){4854      var p = String(s).split('-'), d = new Date(Date.UTC(+p[0], +p[1]-1, +p[2]));4855      d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()-1);4856      return d.getUTCFullYear()+'-'+pad(d.getUTCMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(d.getUTCDate());4857    }4858    function dayAfter(s){4859      var p = String(s).split('-'), d = new Date(Date.UTC(+p[0], +p[1]-1, +p[2]));4860      d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()+1);4861      return d.getUTCFullYear()+'-'+pad(d.getUTCMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(d.getUTCDate());4862    }4863    function timeline(rows){4864      var order = rows.map(function(r, i){ return { r:r, i:i }; })4865                      .sort(function(a, b){ return a.r.from < b.r.from ? -1 : a.r.from > b.r.from ? 1 : 0; });4866      order.forEach(function(o, n){4867        o.to = n < order.length-1 ? dayBefore(order[n+1].r.from) : null;4868      });4869      return order;4870    }4871    /* Day 1 and Day 2 are SEPARATE timelines. '—' : Number(v).toFixed(2)+'%'; }48934894    /* ---- inline editing ---- */4895    function cell(i, key, type, text, extra){4896      return '<td class="cfg-edit'+(type==='pct'?' num':'')+(extra?' '' : raw;4908      td.textContent = ''; td.appendChild(input); input.focus();4909      var done = false;4910      function commit(){4911        if (done) return; done = true;4912        var v = input.value;4913        if (type === 'pct') v = v === '' ? '' : Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(v)));4914        if (String(v) !== String(raw)) {4915          rows[i][k] = v;4916          rows[i].by = USER;4917          rows[i].at = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);4918          save(storeKey, rows);4919        }4920        redraw();4921      }4922      input.addEventListener('blur', commit);4923      input.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){4924        if (e.key === 'Enter') commit();4925        if (e.key === 'Escape') { done = true; redraw(); }4926      });4927    }49284929    /* ---- the "+ 新增" row ----4930       It lives IN the table, as the last row of its own timeline, because that4931       is where the row it creates will appear. The header row above a report4932       table is the filter row everywhere else in the portal, and a config table4933       has nothing to filter — putting an editor's controls there made this page4934       look like it had filters it does not have. */4935    function addRow(cols, key, label){4936      return '<tr class="cfg-add"><td colspan="'+cols+'" data-add="'+key+'">'4937           + '+ ' + label + '</td></tr>';4938    }49394940    /* ---- table 1 — On-time Delivery Rate ---- */4941    function tierLabel(tier){ return tier === 2 ? 'Day 2' : 'Day 1'; }4942    function renderPod(){4943      var view = timelineByTier(pod);4944      var html = '<thead><tr>'4945        + '<th class="c0">'+T('Configuration Type','配置类型')+'</th>'4946        + '<th class="grp">'+T('Target','目标值')+'</th>'4947        + '<th class="grp">'+T('Effective From','生效日')+'</th>'4948        + '<th>'+T('Effective To','截止日')+'</th>'4949        + '<th>'+T('Status','状态')+'</th>'4950        + '<th class="grp">'+T('Updated By','修改人')+'</th>'4951        + '<th>'+T('Updated At','修改时间')+'</th>'4952        + '<th></th></tr></thead><tbody>';4953      var lastTier = null;4954      view.forEach(function(o){4955        var st = statusOf(o, TODAY), i = o.i, r = o.r;4956        // Day 1 and Day 2 are separate timelines, so each gets its own add row,4957        // closing its own block.4958        if (lastTier !== null && r.tier !== lastTier) {4959          html += addRow(8, lastTier, T('Add ','新增 ') + tierLabel(lastTier));4960        }4961        lastTier = r.tier;4962        html += '<tr class="'+(st==='active'?'cfg-live':'')+'">'4963             +  '<td class="c0">'+tierLabel(r.tier)+'</td>'4964             +  cell(i,'target','pct',tpct(r.target),'grp')4965             +  cell(i,'from','date',r.from,'grp')4966             +  '<td class="dim">'+(o.to ? esc(o.to) : '—')+'</td>'4967             +  '<td>'+statusCell(st)+'</td>'4968             +  '<td class="grp dim">'+esc(r.by)+'</td>'4969             +  '<td class="dim">'+esc(r.at)+'</td>'4970             +  '<td><span class="cfg-del" data-del="'+i+'" title="'+T('Delete','删除')+'">✕</span></td>'4971             +  '</tr>';4972      });4973      if (lastTier !== null) html += addRow(8, lastTier, T('Add ','新增 ') + tierLabel(lastTier));4974      document.getElementById('podTable').innerHTML = html + '</tbody>';4975    }49764977    function renderOfd(){4978      var view = timeline(ofd);4979      var html = '<thead><tr>'4980        + '<th class="c0">'+T('OFD Cut-off','出仓截止时点')+'</th>'4981        + '<th class="grp">'+T('Target','目标值')+'</th>'4982        + '<th class="grp">'+T('Effective From','生效日')+'</th>'4983        + '<th>'+T('Effective To','截止日')+'</th>'4984        + '<th>'+T('Status','状态')+'</th>'4985        + '<th class="grp">'+T('Updated By','修改人')+'</th>'4986        + '<th>'+T('Updated At','修改时间')+'</th>'4987        + '<th></th></tr></thead><tbody>';4988      view.forEach(function(o){4989        var st = statusOf(o, TODAY), i = o.i, r = o.r;4990        html += '<tr class="'+(st==='active'?'cfg-live':'')+'">'4991             +  cell(i,'cut','time',r.cut,'c0')4992             +  cell(i,'target','pct',tpct(r.target),'grp')4993             +  cell(i,'from','date',r.from,'grp')4994             +  '<td class="dim">'+(o.to ? esc(o.to) : '—')+'</td>'4995             +  '<td>'+statusCell(st)+'</td>'4996             +  '<td class="grp dim">'+esc(r.by)+'</td>'4997             +  '<td class="dim">'+esc(r.at)+'</td>'4998             +  '<td><span class="cfg-del" data-del="'+i+'" title="'+T('Delete','删除')+'">✕</span></td>'4999             +  '</tr>';5000      });5001      html += addRow(8, 'ofd', T('Add configuration','新增配置'));5002      document.getElementById('ofdTable').innerHTML = html + '</tbody>';5003    }50045005    function latest(rows){5006      var best = null;5007      rows.forEach(function(r){ if (!best || r.from > best.from) best = r; });5008      return best;5009    }5010    function latestOf(rows, tier){5011      return latest(rows.filter(function(r){ return r.tier === tier; }));5012    }50135014    /* A new rule CLONES the newest one on its timeline onto the next free day,5015       so you never start from a blank row — the common edit is "97% becomes5016       98%", not filling seven fields.50175018       The date is derived, not asked for: the day after whichever is later,5019       today or the newest existing rule. That makes it (a) impossible to clash5020       with an existing effective date, and (b) always a FUTURE rule, which is5021       the model — changing a live rule means scheduling a new one, never5022       rewriting a date a past report was already scored against. */5023    function nextFrom(rows){5024      var newest = latest(rows);5025      var base = newest && newest.from > TODAY ? newest.from : TODAY;5026      return dayAfter(base);5027    }5028    function addPod(tier){5029      var b = latestOf(pod, tier) || { target: tier === 2 ? 99 : 97 };5030      var peers = pod.filter(function(r){ return r.tier === tier; });5031      pod.push({ tier:tier, target:b.target, from:nextFrom(peers), by:USER, at:TODAY });5032      save(POD_KEY, pod); renderPod();5033    }5034    function addOfd(){5035      var b = latest(ofd) || { cut:'09:00', target:90 };5036      ofd.push({ cut:b.cut, target:b.target, from:nextFrom(ofd), by:USER, at:TODAY });5037      save(OFD_KEY, ofd); renderOfd();5038    }50395040    function init(){5041      function wire(tableId, rows, storeKey, redraw){5042        document.getElementById(tableId).addEventListener('click', function(ev){5043          var add = ev.target.closest('[data-add]');5044          if (add) {5045            var k = add.getAttribute('data-add');5046            if (k === 'ofd') addOfd(); else addPod(+k);5047            return;5048          }5049          var del = ev.target.closest('[data-del]');5050          if (del) {5051            var i = +del.getAttribute('data-del');5052            // Every timeline must keep at least one row, and for the delivery5053            // table a "timeline" is a tier — deleting the last Day 2 rule would5054            // leave the report with no Day 2 target at all.5055            var row = rows[i];5056            var peers = row && row.tier != null5057              ? rows.filter(function(r){ return r.tier === row.tier; })5058              : rows;5059            if (peers.length <= 1) { alert(T('At least one configuration must remain.','至少需保留一条配置。')); return; }5060            if (confirm(T('Delete this configuration?','确认删除该配置？'))) { rows.splice(i, 1); save(storeKey, rows); redraw(); }5061            return;5062          }5063          var td = ev.target.closest('.cfg-edit');5064          if (td) beginEdit(td, rows, storeKey, redraw);5065        });5066      }5067      wire('podTable', pod, POD_KEY, renderPod);5068      wire('ofdTable', ofd, OFD_KEY, renderOfd);50695070      function dl(id, file, sheet, title){5071        if (!window.SPXExport) { alert(T('Export module not ready.','导出模块未就绪。')); return; }5072        window.SPXExport.downloadTable(document.getElementById(id), file, { sheetName:sheet, title:title });5073      }5074      document.getElementById('podDl').addEventListener('click', function(){5075        dl('podTable','ofd_report_delivery_config.xlsx','Delivery',5076           T('On-time Delivery Rate — Target by tier','及时签收率 — 分档目标值'));5077      });5078      document.getElementById('ofdDl').addEventListener('click', function(){5079        dl('ofdTable','ofd_report_cutoff_config.xlsx','OFD Cut-off',5080           T('On-time OFD Rate — Cut-off & Target','出仓及时率 — 截止时点与目标值'));5081      });50825083      renderPod(); renderOfd();5084      (window.__spxOnLang = window.__spxOnLang || []).push(function(){ renderPod(); renderOfd(); });5085    }5086    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);5087    else init();5088  })();5089  <\/script>5090</body>5091</html>50925093</script>5094<script type="text/markdown" id="doc-config-ofd-report">5095# 出仓报表配置 · 开发说明50965097出仓报表考核 SC 自身的派送能力，而「按时」的两条线——出仓截止时点、5098及时签收 Day 1 / Day 2 阈值——是**业务变量**，会随季节、承运结构和考核力度调整。5099这一页是这些变量的**唯一来源**。51005101核心不是"能改数"，而是**按生效日版本化，改配置不改写历史**。5102「趋势」与「单日」两张报表都从这里取规则，任一报表日期按**当日生效**的那一条判定。51035104---51055106## 前端51075108### 两张表，两种形状51095110| 表 | 一行是什么 | 可编辑列 |5111|---|---|---|5112| 及时签收率 | **一个档位的一条生效期配置**（Day 1 或 Day 2） | 目标值、生效日 |5113| 出仓及时率 | 一条生效期配置 | 截止时点、目标值、生效日 |51145115**四列永远只读、由系统生成**：截止日、状态、修改人、修改时间。它们不是输入项，也没有编辑态。51165117### 这一页完全没有筛选，一个都不许有51185119**配置表就是配置表。** 标题下方那条工具栏（`.rpt__tools`）在 portal 的每一张报表上都是筛选行，所以这一页**不能有那一行** —— 有了它，读者就会以为这页可以筛，或者以为那些控件是在过滤当前这张表。51205121具体两条：51225123- 没有「查看日期 / As of」输入。配置表只有一个诚实的读法：**现在生效的是哪一条**，「状态」列直接与**今天**比较得出。加 as-of 会让「状态」这一列的含义变成「在你随便选的某一天的状态」，那不是列名说的东西。5124- **新增用的控件也不许放在那一行。** 它们不是筛选，却坐在筛选的位置上 —— 见下。51255126这一页只回答一个问题：**当前口径是什么，接下来会变成什么。**51275128### 新增做在表格里，不做在表头51295130「+ 新增」是**表格的最后一行**，不是标题栏上的按钮。位置即语义：新增出来的行会出现在表格里，触发它的东西就该在表格里。51315132- **每条时间线各有一个新增行**：签收表有 Day 1、Day 2 两条时间线，就有两个新增行，各自封在自己那一段的末尾；出仓表只有一条，只有一个。5133- 新增行读起来必须是**动作而不是数据**：不参与达标着色、没有状态、没有可编辑单元格的悬停描边。51345135### 生效日是推导出来的，不问用户51365137点新增**不弹表单、不需要先选日期**：51385139- **克隆同一条时间线上最新的那条规则**（目标值、截止时点一起带过来）—— 常见动作是「把 97% 改成 98%」，不是从零填七个字段；5140- **生效日 = max(今天, 该时间线最新生效日) 的次日**。51415142这个推导同时保证两件事，都是模型要求，不是图省事：514351441. **不可能与已有生效日撞车**（它永远比最大的那个还大），所以不需要冲突校验，也就不需要报错弹窗；51452. **新规则永远在未来生效** —— 改一条已生效的规则的做法是排一条新的，而不是改写某个历史报表日期当时被判定的依据。51465147建完之后直接点该行的目标值改数即可（就地编辑）。51485149### 没有「版本」这个概念51505151行不带 v1/v2/v3 编号，按钮写「**+ 新增**」而不是「+ 新增版本」。51525153一条规则的唯一把手是它的**生效日**。加一个编号只会让人以为版本是个需要单独管理的东西，进而问出「能不能回滚到 v2」这种在这套模型里无意义的问题。51545155### 就地编辑51565157- 可编辑单元格带悬停描边，点击进入编辑；5158- **回车或失焦提交，Esc 取消**；5159- 每次提交自动写入修改人 / 修改时间。51605161### 删除保护51625163**每条时间线至少保留一行。** 对签收表，「一条时间线」= **一个档位**：按 `tier` 计数，不按整表计数。否则可以把最后一条 Day 2 规则删掉，而表里还剩着 Day 1 的行，看上去正常，实际报表已经完全没有 Day 2 目标值了。51645165### 变更的影响必须可见51665167改一条规则不是改一个数 —— 它会改变三张报表在某段日期上的判定。前端应在提交前把**受影响的日期范围**说清楚（这条规则从哪天起生效、覆盖到哪天）。51685169---51705171## 数据51725173### 规则表模型51745175两张全局规则表，**不按大区 / SC / 车队分设**，全网统一适用，无分层级覆盖。51765177| 表 | 字段 |5178|---|---|5179| 签收规则 | `tier`（Day 1 / Day 2）· `target` · `effective_from` · `updated_by` · `updated_at` |5180| 出仓规则 | `cut`（截止时点）· `target` · `effective_from` · `updated_by` · `updated_at` |51815182`updated_by` / `updated_at` 是**审计字段，服务端写入**，不接受前端传值。51835184### 截止时点为什么不在签收模型里51855186签收两档恒为 23:59（Day 1 在 D+0，Day 2 在 D+1）。它从未变过，却曾经在配置表里占一列、在报表的每个目标值单元格里印一遍。现在它是报表侧的一个常量。51875188**如果将来真要按档位配置截止时点，改的是数据模型（加回 `cut` 字段），不是在显示字符串里拼** —— 报表侧已经预留了「非默认值就打印出来」的分支，加字段即可生效。51895190出仓及时率相反：截止时点**是真实的业务变量**，必须留在模型里，且它改变的是度量本身（哪些包裹算准时），而目标值只移动达标线。这两者的区别要在 UI 上让配置人看得出来。51915192### 生效窗口怎么推导51935194按 `effective_from` 升序排列，**每条规则的截止日 = 下一条规则 `effective_from` 的前一天**，最后一条保持开放。51955196**签收表必须先按 `tier` 分组，再各自推导。** 直接在合并列表上推导，一条 Day 1 规则会因为一条不相干的 Day 2 变更而提前结束 —— 这是这个模型最容易写错的一处，务必写单测覆盖。51975198### 每个字段下游可能怎么用51995200列出来是为了说明**为什么要留存这个字段、留到什么精度**。52015202| 字段 | 下游可能的用法 |5203|---|---|5204| 出仓 `cut` | 判定哪些包裹算按时出仓，即出仓及时率的分子边界；单日页的小时格下钻是否返回未达标包裹也由它决定；悬停里的规则文案要把它完整印出来 |5205| 出仓 `target` | 出仓及时率格的达标着色阈值；悬停规则文案 |5206| 签收 `tier` | 区分 Day 1 / Day 2 两条独立时间线，解析时不能跨档 |5207| 签收 `target` | Day 1 / Day 2 各自格子的达标着色阈值；悬停规则文案（只印阈值，不印时点） |5208| `effective_from` | 下游按报表日期做时点解析的依据：生效日 ≤ 该日期的最后一条 |5209| 截止日（推导值） | 界面上显示这条规则管到哪天；也用于让配置人看清两条规则的衔接 |5210| 状态（推导值） | 界面上标出当前生效的是哪一条 |5211| `updated_by` / `updated_at` | 审计追溯：谁在什么时候改了考核口径 |52125213**解析只应有一份实现**：由服务端提供「取某日期某档的生效规则」的接口，下游都调同一个。5214每个消费方各实现一遍解析，是保证它们迟早对不上的做法。52155216### 历史不可改写52175218改配置是**新增一条未来生效的规则**，不是覆盖已有行。任何历史日期都必须继续按当时生效的规则计算——5219考核建立在这上面：目标值一调就把上个月的达标结论重算一遍，考核就不可信了。5220已生效规则的 `effective_from` 与 `target` **不可编辑**。52215222### 待确认522352241. **要不要审批流。** 现在的模型是"已生效不可编辑、只能追加未来生效的规则"，这已经能防改写历史；5225   但排一条未来的规则要不要第二人复核，没有定论。52262. **谁有权限改这两张表。** 它们改的是全公司的考核口径，读权限和写权限显然不该一样，5227   但具体给到哪个角色没定。52283. **未来生效的规则在生效前能不能撤回或改。** 它还没影响任何历史日期，所以技术上可以，5229   但撤回要留痕还是直接删，没定。52304. **签收截止时点将来若要可配。** 现在恒为 23:59 且不在模型里；真要配就加回 `cut` 字段，5231   不要在显示字符串里拼——下游已经预留了"非默认值就打印出来"的分支。52325. **是否会有分层级覆盖的需求**（某个大区用更严的目标值）。现在是全网统一、无覆盖；5233   一旦要分层，解析接口的入参和这两张表的主键都要改。52345235</script>5236<script type="text/html" id="mod-config-staffing-sc">5237<!DOCTYPE html>5238<html lang="en" data-theme="light">5239<head>5240  <meta charset="UTF-8"  <h1 class="page-title" data-t data-en="SC" data-zh="SC">SC</h1>5256        <p class="page-subtitle" data-t data-en="Every service center, the region it belongs to, and the SC Manager accountable for </div>5258    </header>52595260    <script>5261    window.REPORT_INFO = {5262      category: { en: 'Local Staffing and Mapping', zh: '本地人员与映射' },5263      title:    { en: 'SC', zh: 'SC' },5264      purpose: {5265        en: 'The one place an SC is defined: the SC itself, the region it reports into, and the SC Manager accountable for it. SC is the primary key — an SC cell is locked once set. Region is a picker over the regions configured on the Region page, so an SC can be moved between regions here without a second table to keep in step. Bulk-add by uploading a .csv / .xlsx or add rows individually.',5266        zh: 'SC 的唯一定义处：SC 本身、它归属的大区、以及对它负责的 SC 经理。SC 为主键：一旦有值即锁定。大区列是一个下拉，选项来自「大区」页配置的大区，因此调整 SC 的归属大区在本页完成，不需要再维护第二张表。可上传 .csv / .xlsx 批量新增或逐行新增。',5267      },5268      ownership: [{ kind: 'brand', en: 'Configuration', zh: '配置' }],5269      refresh: { en: 'Manual — edited in place', zh: '手动 · 就地维护' },5270      concepts: [5271        { term: { en: 'The SC list lives here', zh: 'SC 名单就在本页' },5272          desc: { en: 'This page defines which service centers exist, which region each reports into, and who runs it — one row per SC, one editable home per fact. A separate SC-to-region mapping table used to hold the first two of those; it carried the same 86 rows with the same regions, so it was removed rather than kept in step.',5273                  zh: '本页定义有哪些分拣中心、每个归属哪个大区、以及由谁负责——一个 SC 一行，一个事实一个可写入口。原先另有一张 SC 与大区映射表承载前两项，它与本页是同样的 86 行、同样的大区，因此不再单独维护。' } },5274        { term: { en: 'Region options come from the Region page', zh: '大区选项来自「大区」页' },5275          desc: { en: 'Region is a picker, not free text: its options are the regions configured on the Region page, so assigning an SC can never invent a region that nothing is staffed for.
